miss_explanations.cause: Band missed on p95 and max (numbers in the gate table). 12.6 % of scan points are over 0.30 mm and 1.8 % over 0.80 mm. The scan is clean (noise ~0.04 mm) and full-res, scale is not the cause, and the over-band points sit on modelled surfaces placed or sized wrong, not on scan artefacts: (1) side-port end walls / U-windows about 1 mm short in -X on both ports (clusters 0, 2, 10; c2s 0, 2); (2) shoulder-block sloped top built as steps (cluster 1); (3) cam-ring x~0 step walls/pockets at theta ~96/270 filled (clusters 6, 7); (4) microswitch side tab too short (5); (5) unenumerated bump under the switch (4) and column lug at 320 deg (8); (6) barb top rib not modelled (3); (7) top-bore floor ~1 mm too high (9); (8) invented wedge at the switch-holder/+Y bracket junction (11; c2s 4). Probe (qa/probe/over_share.json, hypothetical, not a gate): making regions R1..R8 perfect alone would leave p95 ~0.41, so a diffuse 0.3..0.8 mm placement error in the cam ring (CAD mostly in excess, z 0..8.2), the collar/switch-base band (z 8.2..15.4) and the top clip port outline (scan lug outline rounded vs CAD rectangle, overlay Z=45.5) must also be refit.
miss_explanations.options: REVISE (iteration 1 of 3): re-measure and rebuild the named regions from the scan: extend both port blocks and U-window planes to the scanned x ~ -0.1 wall; cut the shoulder-block slope; add the barb rib, switch bump, column lug; lengthen the side tab; lower the top-bore floor; remove the holder/bracket wedge; re-place cap slot 3; refit cam-ring post/tooth/pocket faces and the top-port lug outline. If a later loop still misses p95 0.30 after these, the remainder is a BAND_NOT_MET candidate needing ACCEPT-BAND.

miss_explanations.cause: Band missed on p95 and max. Unobservable fraction is small (~3 %), so the miss is not a coverage artefact: the largest CAD->scan clusters are CAD material placed where the scan shows a different wall (port junctions, c2s 0/2), an invented wedge (c2s 4, up to 3.5 mm), a too-high top-bore floor (c2s 3) and cap slot 3 placed off the scanned loop (c2s 6). The barb bore / port bore interiors are unscanned and count here only where the ray test found line of sight.
miss_explanations.options: same REVISE items as above; the barb/port bore interiors are a coverage fact and cannot be graded without more scan data.

claim_boundary: Not an approved model. This QA result grades iteration 1 against the owner's baseline-skill plastic band on the scan only; it is not evidence of any dimension (no calipers, scale unverified), says nothing about the unscanned interior (bores, spool, passages are not modelled and not graded), and is not fit for tooling, manufacture or mating-part design. Zone Z5 (barb) passing is a local result and does not excuse the whole part.
independence: Fresh QA agent that did not build the model; every gate number re-derived with the stl-re-verify scripts on the full-resolution input/scan.stl (own ICP, own tessellation of the frozen STEP). Not read: build/selfcheck/, build/build_log.txt, measure/params.json values, model.py (grep for loft/ruled/Polyline only). Read as allowed: build/MODELING_PLAN.md, which quotes the builder's own datum-frame self-check aggregates (change log §8); those were not used as expectations. Datum spec, zones and masks were written by QA from INTAKE_CARD.md / alignment.json / coverage.json, masks and zones declared before the first deviation run. Extra QA-only probes (qa/probe/*.py) localise clusters; they are not gates.

The CAD port block stops ~0.9 mm short in -X (MODELING_PLAN §6 assumed the port 'runs into the column to x -1 ... invisible'; the scan shows it is visible). Evidence: overlays x=-0.1 / x=-0.6 / Z=30.8; qa/probe/cluster_probe.json rank 0.
